rows.reasoning: Wanggaard voted Aye (18-15) on Senate concurrence in AB 103 (2025-2026), a single-subject bill whose operative section bars staff from referring to a minor by a name or pronouns not aligned with biological sex "without written authorization from the pupil’s parent or legal guardian", which matches "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns." His AB 510 and AB 963 parental-rights bills and his press-release words point the same way but only show direction.

quotes.text: Of course parents should have the right to determine the name and religion of their child, and see their medical records.
